notes.title: It's Getting Hot - 0.2.1.1
notes.content:
Hey!

You can enjoy the game on Steam Deck!!!

I talked about the Steam Deck at the end.

NEW THINGS



Orb Synergy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/5c6d98820f1b13209b24e0b21aa378a4ae776a3f.png

This is the very beginning of the orb synergy updates. There will be permanent talents added for this soon.

It's in the basic form at the moment, take a look at this page from the Codex to learn what it is:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/d0a8a69eaca39494aa3fa5d39fca4d8e37aaf48e.png

I had to lower the quality to be able to post Codex pages here.



Codex

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/4f4c68523ba11a9ccf3e5ae5d786e1067609fdbd.png

Codex will be kind of a manual, together with lore and credits pages. It is not completed currently, but it will be very soon.



Banish and Reroll for Spells

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/ac1ffc5d3f431593da62534af2df7f66774cc74d.png

I think you know how these work. Banish lets you prevent a spell's upgrades from coming up again, and Reroll rerolls the given upgrades. You start with one from each.

There will be permanent talents added for these soon.



New Items

These are the new items added for the orb synergy, banish, and reroll.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/4810496103cd0e7b14e153a47689ccbac49919dc.png



About the Steam Deck

Orbs of Chaos is playable on Steam Deck, but the controller controls (!) are hard to use at the moment. I am collecting more feedback, and also getting used to playing with controller, and I will do my best to make it more comfortable for everyone.

Probably the path will be to create a different way to do things, but I am not sure at the moment.



FIXES

- Fixed Combusting Existence spell not working.
- Explosive enemies now consistently explode, and they are much more efficient for performance.
- Missing sound effects are added.
- Discord button is now visible in the main menu.

I actually lost my notes for the bugs I fixed, and I honestly cannot remember the rest...

Thanks for being with me during this, it's great to play with you people! Hope you enjoy the new things. I will fix more and add a few missing things tonight or tomorrow.

Take care!!!

notes.title: Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hey!!!

Here’s the roadmap for the near-to-mid future. It’s not in any particular order, and it’ll likely be adjusted as we progress, according to you. I haven’t included the smaller features that will be rolled out continuously while the bigger updates are being prepared.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/68817857cdaac48913b9127e99950ed79e165073.png



 Achievements and cloud saves
 Finalized balance for the current version
 A brand-new orb
 Synergies between orbs
 A new stage in the form of a dungeon crawler (Fun fact: Orbs of Chaos originally started as a dungeon crawler!)
 More secrets, enemies, bosses, and endings for the dungeons and for the normal runs
 New unlocks tied to the upcoming secrets
 Branching talent tree with more talents
 Ways to spend Chaos Orbs during runs
 An enhanced Chaos Mode with endless runs
 Visual improvements along with comfort options
 Full soundtrack release
 Another new orb?.. 
 Bug fixes and more balancing

notes.title: The Great Manipulator Update - 0.2.0.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904722/cb75d7524ec850f5dbbe6b5000b1d93f58d018d2.png

Answer the Call, and fall into the Unknown.

Uncover a new secret, face new enemies, unlock an alternate ending, and extend your runs.

These enemies aren't like anything you've encountered before, but I think you're going to enjoy the challenge.

Also,

- Targeting issues with the Soul Gate spell have been fixed.

- Gold is now displayed correctly at the end of runs.

- Tweaks made to fire and spike spawning spells for better balance.

notes.title: 0.1.0.2 - New stuff and fixes
notes.content:
Hey!

- You can now access your inventory from the pause menu.
- The cursor has been updated. It looks and feels better, with more consistent clicks and no detection issues.


FIXES

- Spires no longer let you pass through them.
- The issue where the Druidess' shrine sometimes drops outside the arena, causing a soft block, has been resolved.
- A secret's issue about skipping songs is fixed.
- Exploding enemies should now work better, though a more permanent fix is coming soon.

Changes have been made based on your feedback! Bigger updates are on the way, but for now, I'm focused on making the game more comfortable, for a few more days. I'll be adding another secret during that time though.

It will never be truly comfortable, don't worry.

Join the Discord and let me know what you’d like to see next!

Another small update will be released today, a bit later.

- Resolution settings now function correctly.
- Fixed the bug where the Tortured Souls spell occasionally left skulls behind.
- Spires finally take damage as intended.
- Inventory view has been improved, with more tweaks coming in the next update.
- Enemy encounters are now more frequent during the first minute.
- Action key assignments are now easier to read (e.g., Mouse0 -> M0, Alpha0 -> 0).
- The XP bar no longer appears full after leveling up.

Join Discord to share your feedback—your input helps shape the updates!

notes.title: 0.1.0.1 - Coolness Update
notes.content:
Hey! Sorry for the delay, had some medical stuff going on, but the cat came back!

- There's now a new realm between the game and main menu.
- Bosses now pull you into their own realms.
- Ending screens give you lots of cool info.
- Fixed some more small but embarrassing bugs.

I'm tackling more bugs and will be pushing out updates more frequently these days. After that, it's time to ball, balance, and rework!

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
These bugs have been fixed. I initially planned to release them alongside the Boss Presentation and End Screens update, but those are taking longer than expected. As a result, those 2 updates will now arrive tomorrow, of course together with more bug fixes.

- Mouth of Madness' arena no longer has holes.
- Nature's Fury, which had issues at higher levels, now functions properly. However, it’s still overpowered and will be reworked in the coming days—though I must admit, I kind of like it that way.
- A boss with 1 HP now has its full HP restored.
- The Druidess can no longer leave her arena. I liked her phasing through trees, so she’ll be reworked soon.
- Another boss with similar arena issues has also been reworked.
- The Shop and Level Up screens can no longer open simultaneously, preventing the soft lock issue.
- Spires not taking damage sometimes has been addressed, though it still needs further testing.
- Collision and knockback logic have been reworked. Enemies can no longer push the player out of obstacles. The feel of pushing and knocking back enemies has been improved and should now be more reliable.

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback, patches are possible with you! I can add new things all the time, but I am not able to be certain that they work all the time on my own. Join us in the Discord server if you want to say your thoughts!

discord

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Sorry for the late update—I've been busy searching for my stinky cat who decided to go on an adventure and hasn't returned yet. She loves wandering around the streets, but she should have come back by now...

- A reset button has been added to restore bindings to their default settings.

- The "Escape" key now reliably cancels the keybinding process.

- Assigning the "Space" key to an action no longer causes issues.

- Fixed buttons that were only responsive in a small area. The reroll, talents, and spell details buttons should now work as intended.

- The Fire Orb's default detail has been removed.

- Added a slight delay to the Shop and Level Up screens to prevent accidental clicks.

- Spires now take damage from all spells and orbs.

- The final boss has been similarly adjusted.

- Music tracks have been lowered and balanced for a better audio experience.

Thank you for playing and helping improve the game! Your support makes it all possible. Join Discord, and tell me what you want to see in the game: invite

Stay tuned for upcoming balance updates and a potential rework of bosses.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
- The first boss should now spawn correctly and won't break the game.

- Fixed a few issues with a secret, and added some sound effects that were prepared but accidentally left out (I forgot).

- Added temporary safeguards for certain issues, with a full fix coming in the morning.

I've collected a lot of bugs and will be addressing them first thing tomorrow (or in the morning? it's already tomorrow for me). Quality of life features will be implemented right after Patch #2, later that same day.

Thank you for playing Orbs of Chaos and for your invaluable feedback! Join the Discord and tell me about your experience!
